answer: Sybil Sieve walks. 1) Each identity acts as a zephyr, broadcasting a small proof of existence, e.g., a unique CAPTCHA solution. 2) Trusted nodes, acting as beacons, randomly select a subset of these zephyrs to verify. 3) Verified zephyrs gain trust weight based on beacon proximity and verification success. Yarrow tokens are awarded proportionally. Cost for N identities is $5 N$. For 1000 identities, cost is $5000.
